description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_Definition' which serves as a base class for other definition data type objects in the HTMLPurifier library. It manages setup state and serialization behavior for definition objects, including properties like 'setup', 'optimized', and 'type', and an abstract method 'doSetup' that subclasses must implement.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Definition
classes.description: An abstract base class for definition datatype objects within the HTMLPurifier library, managing setup status and serialization control, requiring subclasses to implement the 'doSetup' method.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the definition object into its final form. It prevents re-initialization if already set up and calls the subclass-implemented 'doSetup' method.
